script:
-- AI Script Generator GUI
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ScreenGui
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "AIScriptGenerator"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- MainFrame
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 450, 0, 400)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -225, 0.5, -200)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

-- UICorner
local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
uiCorner.Parent = mainFrame

-- TitleLabel
local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Name = "TitleLabel"
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
titleLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
titleLabel.Text = "AI Script Generator"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
titleLabel.TextSize = 18
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
titleLabel.Parent = mainFrame

-- PromptBox
local promptBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
promptBox.Name = "PromptBox"
promptBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 80)
promptBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 70)
promptBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
promptBox.PlaceholderText = "Type your prompt here (e.g., 'Make my player jump really high')..."
promptBox.Text = ""
promptBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
promptBox.TextSize = 14
promptBox.TextWrapped = true
promptBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
promptBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
promptBox.Parent = mainFrame

-- GenerateButton
local generateButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
generateButton.Name = "GenerateButton"
generateButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 40)
generateButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 170)
generateButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 0)
generateButton.Text = "Generate"
generateButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
generateButton.TextSize = 16
generateButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
generateButton.Parent = mainFrame

-- CopyButton
local copyButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
copyButton.Name = "CopyButton"
copyButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 40)
copyButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0, 170)
copyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200)
copyButton.Text = "Copy Script"
copyButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
copyButton.TextSize = 16
copyButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
copyButton.Parent = mainFrame

-- ResultBox
local resultBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
resultBox.Name = "ResultBox"
resultBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 130)
resultBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 230)
resultBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
resultBox.PlaceholderText = "Generated code will appear here..."
resultBox.Text = ""
resultBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
resultBox.TextSize = 12
resultBox.TextWrapped = true
resultBox.TextEditable = false
resultBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
resultBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
resultBox.Parent = mainFrame

-- Function to make dummy text for generation
generateButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local prompt = promptBox.Text
	if prompt ~= "" then
		resultBox.Text = "Generating logic for: '" .. prompt .. "'...\n\n-- Generated AI Script\nlocal player = game.Players.LocalPlayer\nlocal char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()\nlocal humanoid = char:WaitForChild(\"Humanoid\")\n\n-- Applied modification\nprint(\"Executing simulated AI prompt...\")\n"
	else
		resultBox.Text = "Error: Please type a prompt first!"
	end
end)

-- Copy functionality
copyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if resultBox.Text ~= "" then
		setclipboard(resultBox.Text)
		copyButton.Text = "Copied!"
		task.wait(1)
		copyButton.Text = "Copy Script"
	end
end)
